from datetime import timedelta, timezone

def export_rows(events):
    display_zone = timezone(timedelta(hours=-5))
    return [{"id": event["id"], "starts_at": event["starts_at"].astimezone(display_zone).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")} for event in events]
